narr: Numerous showers and thunderstorms made their way across southern Florida as a cold front approached the region. Heavy rain fell with the passing storms leading to flooding across several metropolitan areas along the Atlantic coastline.
ev: Law enforcement reports and pictures relayed from broadcast media indicated numerous areas of street flooding in Jupiter and Tequesta. Main areas include US 1 and Beach Road, Bridge Road and Old Dixie Hwy, Willow Rd and Tequesta Drive, Alt A1A and Eganfuskee Road, Cypress Dr. and Riverside Dr, and Old Dixie Hwy and Eyeball Avenue. A few cars were seen stalled in one of the pictures.||Law enforcement was required to close the following intersections: A1A and US-1, US-1 and Bridge Road, and A1A and Center Street. Rainfall observations from across the area were in the 5-7 inch range in just over 2 hours.

Reports of street flooding from the area around 63rd Street in Miami Beach south to South Beach between Washington and Alton Avenues. Water entered the garage of a home on 63rd Street, and many streets and driveways were flooded in the Mid Beach area from the La Gorce Golf Club area to 34th Street.||Rainfall amounts across the area were in the 2-4 inch range.
